title: Beijing to Shanghai EV Road Trip: China Express Charging Corridor
excerpt: Drive 1200km from Beijing to Shanghai in an EV on China G2 expressway with complete charging guide and family stops.
author: EV Charging Asia Team
content: Write 800+ words here. Cover: route overview 1200km 12 hours. G2 expressway charging every 50km. State Grid 350kW chargers. Stops: Beijing to Jinan 400km. Jinan springs and food. Jinan to Nanjing 550km via Xuzhou. Nanjing history and wall. Nanjing to Shanghai 300km. Total EV cost 300RMB vs petrol 800RMB. Apps: State Grid e-Charging, TELD, Amap. Tips for families: book hotels with charging, snacks at service plazas, download entertainment. Seasons: spring best.
